children: Vietnam's trade surplus narrowed to USD 1.27 billion in September 2026, down from USD 2.97 billion in the same month a year earlier.
It was the first trade surplus since November 2025, as both exports and imports surged.
Exports surged 39.1% from a year earlier to USD 59.48 billion, while imports jumped 48.5% to USD 58.21 billion.

title: Vietnam Posts Trade Surplus for 1st Time in 10 Months
